title: 第520章 不如一起住过来吧第520章 不如一起住过来吧
slug: 多子多福家族帮我攻略极品仙子
lines: 而就在江渊思考时。
这片梦境世界因为刚才的碰撞，已经开始大面积坍塌。
江渊散去凝练的天帝剑意，目光一扫，落在了下方废墟中那截犹如山岳般巨大的断指上。
断指通体呈现出一种灰败的死白色，但在那腐朽的表皮之下却隐隐流转着极其古老、深奥的仙道符文。
“既然留下了点东西，那就给本帝带走吧！”
江渊大手一挥，海量的创生紫气狂涌而出，化作一张遮天蔽日的大网，将那截山岳般的断指死死包裹。
在创生紫气的疯狂压缩下，那截断指迅速缩小，最终化作了常人手指大小，落入了江渊的掌心。
江渊没有再留恋这片即将毁灭的梦境废墟，顺着那根连接现实的紫金丝线，身形化作一道流光，瞬间冲破了梦境与现实的壁垒。
天帝行宫。
现实世界的时间，仅仅过去了几息。
“大哥哥！”
随着一道紫金色的光芒闪过，江渊的身形稳稳地落在了庭院之中。
而在他怀里，原本因为神魂几乎被吞噬而昏睡过去的洛长云，也猛地睁开了眼睛。
小丫头一醒来，就死死地抱住江渊的脖子眼泪像断了线的珠子一样往下掉，哭得撕心裂肺。
“呜呜呜……大哥哥……长云以为再也见不到你了……那个黑漆漆的洞好可怕……里面有怪物要吃长云……”
洛长云把小脸埋在江渊的胸口，鼻涕眼泪全都蹭在了他那件名贵的玄色常服上，小小的身体还在不受控制地发抖。
“没事了，没事了，怪物已经被大哥哥打跑了。”
江渊收敛了那股毁天灭地的杀伐之气，眼神变得柔和，大手轻轻拍着小丫头的后背，将一缕温和的创生紫气渡入她的体内，安抚着她受惊的神魂。
“帝子大人！”
一旁的洛长风看到江渊和妹妹平安归来，那颗悬在嗓子眼的心终于落了地。
这位平日里看破红尘、沧桑老练的梦道准帝，此刻竟是双腿一软，噗通一声跪在了江渊的面前。
她那双总是透着沧桑的眼眸中，此刻溢满了感动的泪水。
“长风……多谢帝子大人救命之恩！若非帝子大人舍命相救，长云她……她恐怕已经……”
洛长风泣不成声，对着江渊重重地磕了一个响头。
她很清楚，强行闯入梦境裂缝是何等危险的举动。
即便是大帝境强者，稍有不慎也会被那混乱的法则同化，神魂俱灭。江渊身为江家帝子，万金之躯，却为了她妹妹，毫不犹豫地涉险。
这份恩情，比天还大！
“起来吧，本帝说过，有本帝在，塌不了天。”
江渊单手托着洛长云，另一只手虚抬，一股柔和的力量将洛长风扶了起来。
“况且，本帝这次进去，也并非毫无收获。”
江渊嘴角勾起一抹神秘的笑意，他缓缓摊开右手。
只见他的掌心之中，静静地躺着一截干枯、灰白，散发着极其恐怖气息的断指！
content_en:
And just when Jiang Yuan was thinking.
This dream world has begun to collapse on a large scale due to the collision just now.
Jiang Yuan dispersed the condensed Heavenly Emperor's Sword Intent and glanced at the severed finger that was as huge as a mountain in the ruins below.
The whole body of the severed finger showed a kind of gray and dead white, but under the decayed surface, extremely ancient and profound immortal runes were faintly flowing.
"Since you have left something behind, let me take it away with you!"
Jiang Yuan waved his hand, and a large amount of purple energy of creation surged out, turning into a large net that covered the sky and the sun, tightly wrapping the severed finger like a mountain.
Under the crazy compression of the purple energy of creation, the amputated finger quickly shrunk, and finally turned into the size of an ordinary human finger, and fell into Jiang Yuan's palm.
"Let's go!"
Jiang Yuan no longer lingered on the ruins of a dream that was about to be destroyed. Following the purple-gold thread connecting reality, his body turned into a stream of light, instantly breaking through the barrier between dreams and reality.
…
The palace of the Emperor of Heaven.
Only a few breaths of time have passed in the real world.
"Big brother!"
As a purple-gold light flashed, Jiang Yuan's figure landed steadily in the courtyard.
In his arms, Luo Changyun, who had fallen asleep because his soul was almost swallowed up, suddenly opened his eyes.
As soon as the little girl woke up, she hugged Jiang Yuan's neck tightly, her tears falling like broken beads, and she cried heartbreakingly.
"Woooooo... Big brother... Changyun thought he would never see you again... That dark hole is so scary... There is a monster inside that wants to eat Changyun..."
Luo Changyun buried his little face in Jiang Yuan's chest, his nose and tears all rubbed on his expensive black uniform, and his little body was still shaking uncontrollably.
"It's okay, it's okay, the monster has been beaten away by big brother."
Jiang Yuan restrained the murderous aura that destroyed the world, his eyes softened, and he gently patted the little girl's back with his big hand, passing a gentle ray of creative purple energy into her body, soothing her frightened soul.
"Your Majesty the Emperor!"
Luo Changfeng, who was on the side, saw Jiang Yuan and his sister returning safely, and the heart hanging in his throat finally fell to the ground.
The quasi-emperor Meng Dao, who was usually able to see through the mortal world and experienced vicissitudes of life, suddenly felt his legs weaken and knelt down in front of Jiang Yuan with a thud.
Her eyes, which were always filled with vicissitudes of life, were filled with tears of emotion at this moment.
"Changfeng... thank you, Lord Dizi, for saving your life! If Lord Dizi hadn't risked your life to save your life, Changyun... she would have been..."
Luo Changfeng burst into tears and kowtowed heavily to Jiang Yuan.
She knew very well how dangerous it was to force her way into the cracks of the dream world.
Even those who are powerful in the Great Emperor realm will be assimilated by the chaotic laws and their souls will be destroyed if they are not careful. As the emperor's son of the Jiang family, Jiang Yuan was rich in wealth, but he did not hesitate to take risks for her sister.
This kindness is greater than the sky!
"Get up, I said, as long as I am here, the sky cannot collapse."
Jiang Yuan held Luo Changyun with one hand, raised his other hand, and a soft force helped Luo Changfeng up.
"Besides, my emperor's entry this time is not without gain."
A mysterious smile appeared at the corner of Jiang Yuan's mouth, and he slowly spread his right hand.
In the palm of his hand, lying quietly, was a dry, gray, severed finger that exuded an extremely terrifying aura!
